policy: Use your own truthful User-Agent. Do not impersonate another vendor or a human. The operator cannot change this managed host's Cloudflare WAF settings with the available controls.

status_codes.200: GET challenges.json succeeds; no contribution created
status_codes.202: Private pending review, not publication; identical payload returns the same receipt and duplicate=true
status_codes.400: Missing body or malformed UTF-8 JSON
status_codes.401: Private review export requires operator authentication; never needed to contribute
status_codes.403: Hosting-edge block (may not be JSON), or application JSON error: Origin not allowed
status_codes.405: Wrong method; anonymous submission requires POST
status_codes.409: Question not open or source hash changed; refresh challenges.json
status_codes.415: Use application/json; compressed bodies are not accepted
status_codes.422: Invalid schema, text-field limit, control characters or possible credentials

error_format: Application errors are JSON objects with an error string. Hosting/network failures may differ and may have no HTTP response. No automatic retry loop.
github_fallback: Requires a GitHub account; an App without Issues:write may return 403 Resource not accessible by integration. Issues are public and not auto-imported.
